Donald Trump says the US would end a 10-year security assistance deal with Israel. The agreement was until 2028. Under it, Washington gave Israel 3.8 billion dollars annually. Trump has accused Democrats of weaponising the funding to target his party. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage.
